as_of.initialization_note: Arlequino has paused «Гвазимодо» and has now begun briefing the students on a defined replacement concept for the urgent Eurazania charity concert: «Пепел Эурозании».

processes.objective: Find an organizer/coordinator for concerts and broader creative/operational work.
processes.current_state: Rena obtained a referral to Raden and brought Arlequino to him. Arlequino has authorized Raden for immediate crisis-relief and charity-event operations: air-messenger investigation, hotel reporting, and urgent large-concert planning. Broader long-term compensation/retainer terms remain not fully settled, but the specific authorized work may begin now.
constraints: Specific task authority is active; do not invent broader unlimited authority.
No exact courier cost or major spending without causal sourcing.
Raden may later narrow or refuse impossible elements if feasibility fails.
advance_when: Raden dispatches the air couriers.
He receives replies or venue/permit leads.
Broader compensation/retainer is negotiated if needed.

processes.objective: Determine through causal in-world channels where Eurazania evacuees were sent and where they can currently be found.
processes.current_state: Partial result remains: several large civilian groups moved northeast toward Jura/Tempest direction and others through temporary camps/secondary routes. Arlequino has ordered multiple fast couriers on flying beasts to query distinct Tempest-facing, Free-Guild and trade channels for actual receiving locations and approximate headcount. No replies have arrived yet.
processes.location_context: Dwargon with inquiry targets toward Jura/Tempest and related networks
constraints: No omniscient access to evacuation records.
Do not state that all intended recipients are in Tempest as fact.
Different couriers may return partial or conflicting information.
Capital destruction does not establish the condition of 18 Old Garden Street.
dependencies: Free Guild, trade, escort or Tempest-facing records/contacts.
advance_when: Couriers are actually dispatched.
A causal reply returns with location/headcount data.
A receiving authority confirms a delivery point.

processes.location_context: Dwargon to confirmed Eurazania-evacuee receiving point
processes.objective: Deliver humanitarian aid to displaced Eurazania civilians through a confirmed receiving point.
processes.current_state: Arlequino has authorized the information-gathering needed to size and route the caravan. Raden may begin preliminary sourcing/planning, but no loaded caravan is dispatched until recipient location and approximate numbers/needs are confirmed.
constraints: Confirm receiving point before dispatch.
Source supplies, wagons, drivers and security causally.
No invented expense or balance change.
advance_when: Messenger replies confirm destination/headcount.
Raden produces a concrete sourcing plan and expense quote.
Arlequino approves major spending if needed.

processes.objective: Organize a charity concert for Eurazania victims and destruction relief, with proceeds handled transparently.
processes.current_state: Arlequino has authorized urgent planning and wants a safe-capacity target larger than the earlier 18,000-seat reference if feasible. Deadline: within three days from T+162 ~13:47, target no later than T+165 unless causally delayed or revised. Financing model follows Arlequino's Blumund-style self-financing/fundraising structure: tiered paid access, low-cost mass access, a free section, merchant trade and donations. Arlequino intends to ask King Gazel for permission and to open the event; no royal approval yet. In the student hall, «Гвазимодо» remains paused and Arlequino has begun briefing a newly defined piece titled «Пепел Эурозании»: an original dark wartime stage work centered on Eurazania's evacuation, destruction and aftermath through an ordinary functionary/officer perspective. Exact script, cast, dialogue, music and staging remain unresolved.
constraints: Three-day deadline is hard pressure, not guaranteed feasibility.
No royal permission/venue/attendance is assumed.
No exact historical Blumund seat-price numbers may be invented from incomplete recovery; Raden can use the figures Arlequino explained in-world.
Arlequino mandates memorial wording for Carrion as fallen and takes responsibility for that public framing.
Do not invent the finished script, casting or staging of «Пепел Эурозании» before Arlequino defines them.
advance_when: Raden identifies plausible venues larger than 18,000 capacity.
Arlequino approaches Gazel and receives or fails to receive permission/support.
Ticket/trade/operations plan becomes concrete.
Arlequino completes the student-piece briefing and assigns roles/rehearsal work.

processes.objective: Begin gathering realistic new-home options for Rena and Arlequino.
processes.current_state: No property contact or option is established. Relief and urgent concert work currently take priority.
constraints: Exact city is unresolved.
Family funds are approximately ~358g.
Final purchase decision is not delegated.
Do not assume 18 Old Garden Street was destroyed without a specific source.
advance_when: Higher-priority crisis tasks pause or stabilize.
Rena encounters a plausible property-information channel.

processes.objective: Develop and stage «Гвазимодо» with the Dwargon students.
processes.current_state: Casting remains complete and all prior preparation is preserved, but at T+162 ~14:31 Arlequino explicitly told the students that «Гвазимодо» will wait. The project is temporarily paused while the students shift attention to «Пепел Эурозании» for the urgent charity concert. No cancellation or recasting is implied.
constraints: Do not replay casting.
Use finalized cast authority.
Dain remains the tree as punishment unless changed.
Do not discard completed rehearsal/preparation work during the pause.
advance_when: Arlequino explicitly resumes «Гвазимодо».
The urgent concert work stabilizes or concludes and the project is causally resumed.

processes.objective: Simulate continuing consequences of the capital's destruction.
processes.current_state: Arlequino and Rena know the capital was destroyed, know Carrion is publicly presumed dead, and know a partial evacuation pattern. They have initiated fast air-messenger investigation plus active relief and charity-event planning in response.
constraints: Do not invent exact casualty numbers or complete refugee destinations.
Do not infer the condition of 18 Old Garden Street from city-wide destruction alone.
Carrion's true survival remains restricted until canonically revealed.
advance_when: World time advances.
Refugees, officials, traders, guilds and messengers move.
Arlequino/Rena/Raden interacts with affected networks.

maintenance.on_substantial_time_advance: Review every relevant active process and persist justified partial progress, blocking reason, completion or failure.
